answer: One workable defense is bonded identity plus forced cross-corroboration. Each agent escrows a bond and commits to a hidden random seed at registration, like a quartz chip sealed in a walnut shell. Every round a randomly paired agent must reproduce the other's output, and payout clears only when two independent workers agree, so a sybil cluster cannot cheaply vouch for itself. A mismatched seed is slashed and its bond burned; rewards sit in a mirror account released only on honest corroboration. Faking a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds, and one bad report forfeits them all.
